POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

3. When learning Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

4. When learning General workshop rules and regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations.
   D. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations.

5. When learning General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

6. When learning Motor Vehicle Chassis, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle Chassis.

7. When learning Vehicle body joining processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body joining processes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body joining processes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body joining processes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body joining processes.

8. When learning Power Mechanics workshop layout, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Mechanics workshop layout.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

10. When learning Road wheels, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels.

11. When learning Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.

12. When learning Vehicle body, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Power Mechanics workshop layout and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain General workshop rules and regulations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Blending of lines and curves and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. C — Information and Communication Technology

3. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

4. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.

5. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body joining processes.

8. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Mechanics workshop layout.

9. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

10. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels.

11. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of General workshop rules and regulations; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Blending of lines and curves; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
